name: Nenotori
source:
"Nenotori" is an omnibus-story silhouette cuckoldry ADV game.

- Choose one of three stories at the beginning
- Your actions during in the story won't change it, each story is linear
- The setting is an alternate world where "golden birds" exist
- Original story, but also an homage to the classic manga

[Taken and corrected from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE179700.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
《Nenotori》是一款综合故事剪影绿奸ADV游戏。

- 从一开始的三个故事中选择一个
- 你在故事中的行为不会改变它，每个故事都是线性的
- 背景是存在“金鸟”的异世界
- 原创故事，也是对经典漫画的致敬

[摘自并更正自 [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE179700.html]DLsite English[/url]]
